title: CLI foundation: bin target, arg parsing, store builder
description: Wire the CLI shell the five phase-1 verbs sit on: a [[bin]] target (thin main.rs over a library cli module so specs can test behavior), clap arg parsing with the global flags from the cli design (773667dc) (-s/--source repeatable, --root, --home, -o/--output human|json|ndjson, exit codes 0/1/2/3), and the store-builder that builds a SessionStore of real adapters by source name (claude_code, cursor, codex) honoring SourceOptions. Updates the library-only doc claims (README, lib.rs) that the CLI now supersedes.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: [[bin]] botspy + thin main.rs; library cli module with clap arg definitions (global flags: -s/--source repeatable, --root, --home, -o/--output human|json|ndjson, --no-truncate) and run_from/RunOutcome plumbing the specs exercise in-process; store builder wiring real adapters by name with per-agent root derivation (--home / BOTSPY_HOME / $HOME; codex root is ~/.codex not .codex/sessions, cursor root is the state.vscdb file); Adapter impls for the five real sources (their RefCell state became Mutex so they are Sync behind Arc<dyn Adapter>); executable steps for features/cli/. Spec run: 36 CLI scenarios fail on todo!() verbs (red), 3 plumbing scenarios pass. Library-only doc claims updated in lib.rs. README on develop already describes the CLI working-backwards, including the not-yet-built verbs; left as-is.
